notes.title: ATAK Christmas is here - Demo Update 0.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43161469/76f3a0d6a380fb4962548c246c1f94b02c8a13e2.png[/img][b] Demo Update 0.1[/b]

We are glad to announce the first update on the recently launched Demo Version of ATAK. Since Christmas is coming really soon, we thought that it was a good idea to include that holiday spirit in the game. Merry Christmas everyone, wishing you the best of holidays. 

Update Notes
[list]
[*] [b]Stage Changes[/b]: Added a new weather system (snowfall), and a new interactable snow system on the ground. An interactable tree at the middle of the stage which you can shake to let the snow fall from it and change the lights sequence.
[*] [b]Minigame Changes[/b]: A sharing gifts minigame where you ride your horse and try to aim for the right person to give the gift. Like you are Santa Claus on a horse!
[*] Several other improvements in the environment and interaction between the units
[*] Fixed some minor gameplay bugs reported by the Discord Community
[*] Other tweaks on the Stage and the minigames.
[/list]
